dialogues.speaker: Tiger Li
dialogues.text: Ah, now that's a face I've never seen before. Are you with those masked people?

dialogues.speaker: Player
dialogues.text: A face you've never seen before?

dialogues.speaker: Tiger Li
dialogues.text: I know everyone on this island. I've never seen you before. So, you must have come here after my arrival.

dialogues.speaker: Tiger Li
dialogues.text: According to our customs, that makes you my junior!

dialogues.speaker: Tiger Li
dialogues.text: If you ever run into any troubles, just come and find me!

dialogues.speaker: Player
dialogues.text: Masked people?

dialogues.speaker: Tiger Li
dialogues.text: Uh huh, Mr. Guard over there told me that we can't leave this island yet.

dialogues.speaker: Tiger Li
dialogues.text: However, I saw all those masked people heading towards Narukami Island with my own eyes.

dialogues.speaker: Tiger Li
dialogues.text: Inazuma is such a weird place!

dialogues.speaker: Player
dialogues.text: Goodbye.

dialogues.speaker: Tiger Li
dialogues.text: Goodbye!

dialogues.speaker: Player
dialogues.text: Why did you come to Ritou?

dialogues.speaker: Tiger Li
dialogues.text: Because of my big brother! He's a great businessman!

dialogues.speaker: Tiger Li
dialogues.text: I heard from my parents that he's a very brave man. Brave enough to leave home and venture out to sea alone.

dialogues.speaker: Tiger Li
dialogues.text: He's my idol, and I wanna be someone like him. That's why I also left home and snuck in here with him.

dialogues.speaker: Tiger Li
dialogues.text: I really miss my mom, but my brother's still here, so I've gotta stick it out here!

dialogues.speaker: Tiger Li
dialogues.text: Ah, now that's a face I've never seen before. Are you one of those people who traveled back to Liyue on those big ships?

dialogues.speaker: Player
dialogues.text: A face you've never seen before?

dialogues.speaker: Tiger Li
dialogues.text: I was on the first big ship that returned to Liyue together with my brother, so I know everyone who was on that ship.

dialogues.speaker: Tiger Li
dialogues.text: But I've never seen you before, and that means you must've been on one of the later ships.

dialogues.speaker: Tiger Li
dialogues.text: According to our customs, that makes you my junior!

dialogues.speaker: Tiger Li
dialogues.text: So if you ever run into any troubles, just come and find me!

dialogues.speaker: Player
dialogues.text: Your brother?

dialogues.speaker: Tiger Li
dialogues.text: That's right! He's a great businessman!

dialogues.speaker: Tiger Li
dialogues.text: I heard from our parents that he's a very brave man. Brave enough to leave home and venture out to sea alone.

dialogues.speaker: Tiger Li
dialogues.text: He's my idol, and I wanna be someone like him. That's why I followed him out to sea in secret!

dialogues.speaker: Tiger Li
dialogues.text: But since he misses Mom, I decided to come back together with him.

dialogues.speaker: Tiger Li
dialogues.text: I'm not sure when we'll be able to go out together again...

dialogues.speaker: Player
dialogues.text: See you.

dialogues.speaker: Tiger Li
dialogues.text: Seeya!
